meta.description: MixPad 12 is a 12.3-inch, 16:6 panoramic smart home panel with voice control, hi-fi stereo speakers and support for up to 300 Zigbee devices.
sec2.title: Wide beyond the horizon, beautiful beyond words
sec2.desc: A new design language that shows off its pioneering character. Once it's on the wall, it outshines everything around it.
sec4.title: A living picture screen, the height of tech design
sec4.desc: On standby, MixPad 12 switches to a moving picture mode. Seen from across the room, it looks just like a painting.
sec5.title:
16:6 panorama,
read at a glance
sec5.desc: 4:3 or 16:9? Neither! To make reading effortless, we designed a golden ratio for interacting on the move around your home, so one quick glance gives you exactly the information you need.
sec6.title: Custom-made 5th-generation ultra-clear panoramic screen
sec6.size.title: 12.3 in
sec6.brightness.title: 400 nits
sec6.coating.title: AF coating
sec6.lifespan.title: Built for 15 years
sec7.title: Suggests your go-to scenes, handier with every use
sec7.desc: The large 12.3-inch screen holds controls and scenes for more of your devices. The smart scenes and appliances you use most are recommended first on the home screen, so smart living gets even easier.
sec8.title: 15 scenes on one screen
sec8.desc: No paging through menus, one tap and it's on.
sec9.title: Linear dual-mic array, wakes from 10 m away
sec9.desc: Front-facing microphones and a noise-cancelling algorithm remove echo effectively. A 10-meter wake-up range is what your extra-wide living room deserves.
sec10.title: Hi-fi stereo wall speaker, big sound in a slim panel
sec10.tws:
Pairs with external
TWS Bluetooth speakers
sec11.title: Your whole smart home on one screen
sec11.desc: A single MixPad 12 connects up to 300 Zigbee devices, and by cascading local gateways it can run more than a thousand smart home devices.
sec12.title: A butler for every appliance, no more service worries
sec12.desc: Why isn't the air conditioner cooling? Why is the water purifier so slow? No need to wonder. MixPad 12 shows each appliance's status and consumption in real time and answers your questions. You don't have to check on your devices; just enjoy the convenience and health they bring.
sec13.title:
ORVIBO Butler
A whole-home smart assistant, and much more
sec13.desc: Clever, and a pleasure to talk to.
sec13.video_subhead: Say hello first? Forget it, just say what you need!
sec13.video_desc: ONE STEP has been upgraded: control things in one step without a wake word, and now you can change the commands however you like. It's the details that make it great. Everyone who tried it loved it, and now there's version 2.0.
sec13.video_subhead2: A real voice that sounds like an old friend
sec13.video_desc2: Voice interaction that sounds human, pleasant in every sentence. It comes from an AI engine trained with complex machine learning, including word segmentation, part-of-speech tagging and phonetic annotation, on a huge body of Chinese sentences.
sec13.video_subhead3: Smart and fair: the closest one answers
sec13.video_desc3: Even with several MixPads, you won't get a chorus of replies: only the closest one answers. Thanks to our pioneering voice-location technology, nearby wake-up is now faster and more accurate.
sec14.title: A proactive smart engine that looks after your home
sec14.desc: In short: it does the work, you don't have to worry.
sec14.video_title: Home late after a night out
sec14.video_desc: You get home late and the family is asleep, so ORVIBO Butler turns on just one night light to avoid waking anyone.
sec14.video_desc2: The alarm rings, but you want a few more minutes? The assistant reads the situation and wakes you again a little later.
sec14.video_desc3: Closes the windows, plays soothing music and sets warm lighting for a cozier mood.
meta.spec.description: MixPad 12 smart panel specifications: 12.3-inch 1920 × 720 screen, quad-core CPU, Zigbee, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi and RS485, two lighting circuits.
spec.housing: Housing: V0 flame-retardant PC + aluminum alloy
spec.backBox: Back box: standard single 86 mm box
